title: After the Japan Cup: To the Throne Where Roses Bloom

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, who will make the first move?!
They've dipped under the final 400 meters!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Go, go...!
Take total command of this grand stage!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (My dream is the eternity of my clan—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (The unchanging smiles of the Rose clan, blooming even into the distant future...!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am...!
The horse girl of the 'Rose Kingdom'—!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Across the finish line!!
In first place, Rose Kingdom!
(Woooaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Not Buena, but Rose Kingdom—?!
Wait, she's from the Rose Clan! So that's the legendary Rose Clan...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, the Classic-tier runners really keep things exciting!
I can't wait to see how they perform in the Senior tier!

text_block_list.name: Little Rose Clan Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaah! Big Sister Rooose~!
Congratulatiooons~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Color me impressed.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The stands are a whirlpool of frenzy—
A circle brought forth by your love, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will not lose next time.
Not as someone who has walked this path beside you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...It hurts.
It's so frustrating... I hate this...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget these feelings.
Neither this bitter frustration, nor the burning passion I felt from you, Rose-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep every single piece of it in my heart.
And next time, I swear I will win!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...—aagh!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! And to my entire clan,
Pisa, Flash-senpai, Ruler...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Buena!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Having trained and faced this race together,
without my rivals, without my friends,
this victory would never have been possible.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Borrowing everyone's strength,
I shall forge ahead toward victory in the next race as well!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: For a future where roses bloom!
(Woooooaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
I must give you my thanks as well—
choice_data_list: It was a truly... magnificent victory!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, —aah!

Surpassing a field of formidable rivals,
Rose Kingdom seized victory.

Roars of shock and elation filled the racecourse—
and that fervor did not fade for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Japan Cup... To know it brought you
such profound joy fills my heart to the brim.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to watch over me.
I thank you dearly for your congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Has there ever been a time before when my smartphone was quite this lively?
choice_data_list: The estate must be especially overflowing with joy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I must show my face there once again.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: So—how are the analysis results?

I turned my laptop screen toward her.
It displayed a chart illustrating the public reactions to the Japan Cup across social media.
Astonishingly, social media was completely flooded with the words 'The Rose Clan'.

It appears to have reached a broad audience beyond
just racing fans. Moreover, the reception has been
almost entirely positive.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
—It seems it reached them.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: 'Top Reasons the Rose Clan Is Unreal! Rose Kingdom's Greatest Feats'—what is this?

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
“Today, I'd like to talk about Rose Kingdom,
the Umamusume who made waves in the Japan Cup!”

text_block_list.name: UmaTuber
text_block_list.text:
“Who is Rose Kingdom?! What on earth is the Rosen Clan?!
If you're curious, check it out~☆”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
'So the Rose Clan is descended from French aristocratic Umamusume?'
'They even have trainers affiliated specifically with the clan. Maybe I should apply too.'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“There was someone who used to duel Air Groove, right?”
“Honestly though, Rose Kingdom is so cool~”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Haha!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. I was caught slightly off guard, but—spreading
word of our exploits is something to be grateful for.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...If I recall, we also received an interview request from a magazine, correct?
It was primarily regarding the Rose Clan—was it not?

Word came from the major racing publication Monthly Twinkle
that they wished to run a special feature
on the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To think I would feel the shift among the people
to such a degree.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Would it be conceit to feel
that I have finally pulled ahead of the rest?

There is a marked change from before the Japan Cup.
Surely, this has brought us a great step closer
to establishing the prestige of the 'Rose Kingdom'.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, regarding our next race.
I would like to propose the Arima Kinen.
The Arima Kinen—the year-end Grand Prix where the participating Umamusume are chosen by fan vote.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is, in a sense, a grand festival for racing fans.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: To repay those who cast their votes for me. And to kindle an even greater fervor.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: If I can achieve this, then I—and the House of the Rose—shall become an entity that commands guaranteed victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I intend to solidify today's momentum at the Arima Kinen,
and thereby firmly establish our prestige.
choice_data_list: We shall surely see it through.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. There is little time left before year's end.
Let us polish our form and dye Nakayama in shades of rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(No matter what happens, without fail.
—With every fiber of my being.)
